headline: Godcrofts Passes to Colonial Hands; Weathered Expanse Rekindles
war_summary: Three hours after our last edition, Godcrofts has reversed its alignment: the Colonials now hold six of its nine works against three Warden, with five Colonial captures logged in the day and fresh flag actions at Argosa, Lipsia and Saegio scarcely an hour old. Weathered Expanse, the day's costliest ground at better than nineteen thousand casualties, has flared anew — nine actions in the past two hours, twenty-seven in twenty-four, Wightwalk and Spirit Watch the storm-centers. Stlican Shelf remains the busiest field by count, forty-seven actions and The Pale House struck twenty times, while the Dead Lands answered with five actions in two hours about Callahan's Boot and eighteen thousand fallen. Linn of Mercy quickened with five actions inside the last two hours; Callahan's Passage, quiet of flags since morning, bled heavily after a double turnover at The Latch. Stonecradle's grind has slackened. No ruin stands anywhere now, the tally reading 270 works Colonial against 159 Warden on the 173rd day, thirty-four victory towns still the prize and no victor named.
